schema.description: One appointment with a clinic or practitioner. Written by hand readings of notes compiled from appointment emails, and of documents that show a visit.

date.description: The appointment's date and time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in Sydney local time; 00:00 when time_unknown is true. This is the fact time.

id.description: Identity, chosen by the reader: a slug for the provider and the date.

kind.description: The appointment type as the booking named it, close to its wording; where a visit is known only from a document, what that document records happening (such as a summary being printed).

location.description: The address as the source gave it.

note.description: Anything else the reader took from the source about this visit.

outcome.description: What came of the visit, in the reader's words: what a later document shows followed from it, or that no result was found.

provider.description: The practitioner or practice as the source named them.

purpose.description: What the visit was for, as the booking or the note gave it, briefly; the times of separate parts in brackets when there are several.

specialty.description: The provider's field, in the reader's words, lower case.

time_unknown.description: True when the source gives the day but no time, so the 00:00 in date is a placeholder. Absent otherwise.
